feedback.problem: Suppose $|\,c\,|=5$ and the angle between vectors $c$ and $d$ is $\theta =\frac{\pi }{2}.$ Find the scalar projection of $c$ onto $d.$
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the formula for the scalar projection, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{comp}}_{d}\,c & =|\,c\,|\operatorname{cos}⁡\theta  \\  & =5\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi }{2}) \\  & =5\cdot 0 \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
